You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From cde6bcd584b1b910d6ee8d6eb968ea5d20815444 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2016 15:20:02 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: AMD: free memory on error

Static checkers complain if we don't free "adata" before returning.

Fixes: 7c31335a03b6 ('ASoC: AMD: add AMD ASoC ACP 2.x DMA driver')
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/amd/acp-pcm-dma.c b/sound/soc/amd/acp-pcm-dma.c
index 3191e0a7d273..d1fb035f44db 100644
--- a/sound/soc/amd/acp-pcm-dma.c
+++ b/sound/soc/amd/acp-pcm-dma.c
@@ -635,6 +635,7 @@ static int acp_dma_open(struct snd_pcm_substream *substream)
 					    SNDRV_PCM_HW_PARAM_PERIODS);
 	if (ret < 0) {
 		dev_err(prtd->platform->dev, "set integer constraint failed\n");
+		kfree(adata);
 		return ret;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `sound/soc/amd/acp-pcm-dma.c`**
- A line was added to free the memory allocated to `adata` in the `acp_dma_open` function. This line is executed when the function encounters an error after the call to `snd_pcm_hw_param_set_integer_near`.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a memory management issue identified by static checkers, which indicated that the memory allocated for `adata` was not being freed before returning from the function in case of an error. By adding the `kfree(adata);` line, the patch ensures that the allocated memory is properly released, preventing potential memory leaks. This change is directly related to the error handling logic within the `acp_dma_open` function.

2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

Reason: The provided code snippet allocates memory for `adata` but does not free it before returning an error in the case of a failure (e.g., if `snd_pcm_hw_constraint_integer` fails). This oversight can lead to a memory leak, as the allocated memory for `adata` remains unfreed if the function exits early due to an error.
